summary: Verified the bug fix for atomic question types (e.g. yes_no_with_text) in ESG questionnaire _merge_year_responses. Added /app/backend/tests/test_atomic_question_merge.py with 5 pytest tests covering: (1) question configs have response_mode field and all env_assurance_* questions are marked atomic, (2) atomic yes_no_with_text save+reload preserves keys (answer, agency_name) WITHOUT _current_fy/_previous_fy suffixes, (3) multi-year endpoint preserves atomic keys correctly, (4) saving 3 atomic questions simultaneously (env_assurance_energy, env_assurance_water_withdrawal, env_assurance_water_discharged) all round-trip cleanly, (5) regression: FY comparison questions (env_sustainable_rd_capex) still get proper suffixes with no double-suffixing. ALL 5 TESTS PASSED. Frontend end-to-end UI flow also verified via Playwright: login -> Environment -> BRSR Framework -> Assurance subtab -> Edit Mode -> selected 'Yes' for 'Energy consumption data has been audited?' -> filled External Agency Name 'AuditAgency_1782826396' -> Save Responses -> full page reload -> View Mode shows 'Yes' + 'External Agency Name: AuditAgency_1782826396' correctly; re-entering Edit Mode shows Yes radio checked and the input prefilled with the saved agency name. BUG FIX VERIFIED.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified for atomic question types in ESG questionnaire. The fix adds response_mode field to esg_question_configs collection: atomic types (yes_no_with_text, textarea) preserve values as-is via _merge_year_responses; fy_comparison types (tables) still get _current_fy/_previous_fy suffixes. Path: Environment -> BRSR Framework tab -> Assurance subtab. Use button[role='radio'] selectors for Yes/No (radios[0]=energy-Yes, radios[1]=energy-No, etc.). External agency text input appears only after Yes is selected (placeholder='External Agency Name'). The progress counter '0/8 answered' is broken/separate issue. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_atomic_question_merge.py covers both atomic and fy_comparison regression.
rca of the issue: Original bug: _merge_year_responses iterated all keys in nested dicts and unconditionally appended '_current_fy'/'_previous_fy' suffixes, which corrupted atomic question shapes like {answer: 'Yes', agency_name: 'X'} into {answer_current_fy: 'Yes', agency_name_current_fy: 'X'}. The frontend ESGQuestionnaire.js yes_no_with_text handler looks up the bare keys 'answer' and 'agency_name', so the suffixed keys would not match, causing fields to appear empty on reload. Fix: added response_mode ('atomic'|'fy_comparison') to each question config; _merge_year_responses now short-circuits atomic questions and returns the value as-is using current year data (falling back to previous year if absent). FY comparison logic is unchanged. Verified by API tests (5/5 pass) and UI round-trip (Yes + agency name persists across reload in both View and Edit modes).
